newest.title: NVIDIA’s OpenShell Architecture: How Enterprise Agents Get Their Own Security Guard
newest.description: NVIDIA’s OpenShell Architecture: How Enterprise Agents Get Their Own Security Guard. NVIDIA is moving agent security directly into the hardware, and Google is finally letting you run OpenAI models on their cloud. We're breaking down what these infrastructure shifts mean for your next project. What we covered: • NVIDIA launched OpenShell, a reference architecture for safe enterprise AI agents • Google Cloud integrates OpenAI models into Model Garden • NVIDIA said healthcare partners are using a new open protein-design model and AI clinical scientist workflows Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: Would you trust your company's AI agents more if they were confined by hardware-level security? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. Follow The AI Edge on Spotify for a new AI news and analysis episode every weekday.
